title: Opengear Expands OM2200 NetOps Console Server Product Line with Launch of Models with 10GbE Interfaces and 1GbE Ethernet Ports
summary: The first NetOps console server with both Smart Out-of-Band management and advanced automation tools, featuring support for 10GbE network infrastructure as well as 24-port serial and 24-port 1GbE Ethernet
body_markdown: The first NetOps console server with both Smart Out-of-Band management and advanced automation tools, featuring support for 10GbE network infrastructure as well as 24-port serial and 24-port 1GbE Ethernet
